Portronics Power Shutter Air 5K Powerbank – 5000mAh Slim Wireless Power Bank

The Portronics Power Shutter Air 5K Powerbank, 15W Wireless Output, 22.5W Wired Output, In Built Type C Cable, 12mm Slim Size, Capacity: 5000mah, Color: Black is designed for users who want power, portability, and premium design in one compact device. Built for everyday convenience, this ultra-slim power bank delivers fast charging performance while easily fitting into your pocket, purse, or backpack.

With a powerful 5000mAh capacity power bank, the Portronics Power Shutter Air 5K ensures your smartphone, earbuds, or accessories stay charged throughout the day. Whether you are commuting, traveling, or working remotely, this slim wireless power bank offers dependable backup power without added bulk.

Fast & Efficient Charging Performance

The Portronics Power Shutter Air 5K Powerbank supports 15W wireless output for hassle-free cable-free charging. Simply place your compatible smartphone on the power bank and enjoy smooth wireless charging anytime, anywhere. For users who prefer faster wired charging, it delivers an impressive 22.5W wired output, ensuring quick power delivery for supported devices.

Equipped with an in built Type C cable, this Portronics power bank eliminates the need to carry extra cables. The integrated cable makes charging more convenient and keeps your travel essentials minimal and clutter-free.

Ultra-Slim & Travel-Friendly Design

One of the standout features of the Portronics Power Shutter Air 5K Powerbank is its 12mm slim size. The sleek profile makes it one of the best slim power banks in its category. Its lightweight construction ensures maximum portability, making it ideal for daily use, office carry, or long journeys.

Finished in a stylish black color, this power bank complements modern smartphones and accessories. The premium matte finish adds durability while maintaining a clean and professional look.

Smart Safety & Reliable Performance

Safety is a top priority with. The Power Shutter Air 5K power bank is designed with advanced protection features to guard against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits. This ensures safe and stable charging for your devices every time you plug in or charge wirelessly.

Whether you are charging Android smartphones, iPhones, wireless earbuds, or other USB-powered devices, this Portronics wireless power bank offers consistent performance and long-lasting reliability.

Why Choose?

  • 5000mAh capacity power bank for everyday charging needs
  • 15W wireless output for convenient cable-free charging
  • 22.5W wired output for fast and efficient power delivery
  • In built Type C cable for added convenience
  • Ultra-slim 12mm design for easy portability
  • Premium black color with a sleek finish
  • Advanced safety protection for secure charging

Perfect for Daily Use & Travel

The is an excellent choice for professionals, students, and travelers who need a reliable charging solution on the go. Its slim design and wireless charging capability make it a modern power bank solution for today’s fast-paced lifestyle.

If you are looking for a slim wireless power bank with fast charging, built-in cable, and trusted Portronics quality, this 5000mAh power bank is the perfect match. Stay powered, stay connected, and experience smart charging with Portronics.
